svg.text: Matched 1-eV start: rotating survives; standing escapes
100 kTh; 250 V each; 100 kHz; r0=1 mm; azimuth=45.0 deg; phase=0 deg; tangential sign=+1. Standing first passage: 21.309 RF.
Rotating survives the finite 1000-RF horizon; this does not establish permanent stability. The dashed circle is the 8-mm aperture.
